name: Barbarian
body:
Alignment: Any non-lawful

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s barbarian class levels gains the barbarian’s rage class feature. When determining the benefits of their rage and the number of rounds per day they can rage, the apprentice’s effective barbarian level is equal to half his apprentice level (minimum 1). This ability is the same whether the apprentice’s mentor was a barbarian or unchained barbarian.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s barbarian class levels and chooses barbarian for their advanced mentorship ability for the day learns to more effectively rage. When determining the number of rounds per day they can rage, the apprentice’s effective barbarian level is equal his apprentice level. In addition, the apprentice gains a rage power their mentor possesses. At 9th level, 13th level, and 17th level, an apprentice gains an additional rage power their mentor possesses. The apprentice can only gain rage powers known by a mentor in this way. This ability is the same whether the apprentice’s mentor was a barbarian or unchained barbarian.

Cooperation Power

Key abilities: Strength or Constitution

Apprentices who study a mentor’s barbarian class levels and chooses barbarian for their cooperation power may, as a free action, spend a cooperation point to allow any ally or themselves to use Charisma-, Dexterity-, or Intelligence-based skills, or abilities that require patience or concentration while raging. This ability lasts until the start of the apprentices next turn.
